    • bracketedPaste

      public TuiConfig.Builder bracketedPaste(boolean bracketedPaste)
      Sets whether to enable bracketed paste mode.

      When enabled, pasted text containing control characters such as Tab is delivered as a single PasteEvent rather than individual key events.

      Parameters:
      bracketedPaste - true to enable bracketed paste mode
      Returns:
      this builder

    • noTick

      public TuiConfig.Builder noTick()
      Disables automatic tick events.

      Use this for purely event-driven UIs that only need to refresh on user input.

      Returns:
      this builder

    • resizeGracePeriod

      public TuiConfig.Builder resizeGracePeriod(Duration resizeGracePeriod)
      Sets the resize grace period.

      This defines the maximum time before resize events are processed, ensuring the UI redraws promptly on terminal resize even when ticks are disabled or have a long interval.

      Default is 250ms.

      Parameters:
      resizeGracePeriod - the grace period, or null to disable automatic resize handling
      Returns:
      this builder

    • bindings

      public TuiConfig.Builder bindings(Bindings bindings)
      Sets the bindings for semantic action matching.

      Use predefined binding sets from BindingSets:

      • BindingSets.standard() - Arrow keys only (default)
      • BindingSets.vim() - Vim-style navigation (hjkl)
      • BindingSets.emacs() - Emacs-style navigation (Ctrl+n/p/f/b)
      • BindingSets.intellij() - IntelliJ IDEA-style
      • BindingSets.vscode() - VS Code-style
      Parameters:
      bindings - the bindings to use
      Returns:
      this builder

      public TuiConfig.Builder errorOutput(PrintStream errorOutput)

    • postRenderProcessor

      public TuiConfig.Builder postRenderProcessor(PostRenderProcessor processor)
      Adds a post-render processor.

      Post-render processors are called after each frame is rendered, allowing for effects, overlays, or other post-processing. Processors are called in the order they are added.

      Parameters:
      processor - the processor to add
      Returns:
      this builder

    • scheduler

      public TuiConfig.Builder scheduler(ScheduledExecutorService scheduler)
      Sets an externally-managed scheduler.

      When an external scheduler is provided, the runner will NOT shut it down on close - the caller retains ownership and is responsible for its lifecycle.

      This is useful when multiple runners should share a single scheduler, or when integrating with frameworks that manage their own thread pools.

      Parameters:
      scheduler - the scheduler to use, or null to create an internal one
      Returns:
      this builder
